showCpu.name: CPU usage
showCpu.description: Show the CPU usage on the dock item
showCpu.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示 CPU 占用

showTemperature.name: CPU temperature
showTemperature.description: Show the CPU temperature on the dock item
showTemperature.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示 CPU 温度

showMemory.name: Memory usage
showMemory.description: Show the memory usage on the dock item
showMemory.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示内存占用

showSwap.name: Swap usage
showSwap.description: Show the swap usage on the dock item
showSwap.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示交换分区占用

showNetwork.name: Network throughput
showNetwork.description: Show the download and upload rate on the dock item
showNetwork.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示下载与上传速率

showPower.name: Power draw
showPower.description: Show the package power draw on the dock item; the kernel only exposes it to privileged readers on most systems
showPower.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示整机功耗；多数系统上内核只允许特权用户读取该数据

showFan.name: Fan speed
showFan.description: Show the highest fan speed on the dock item
showFan.description[zh_CN]: 在任务栏上显示最高风扇转速

dockChartMode.name: Taskbar charts
dockChartMode.description: How the dock item draws its metrics: off (the numbers alone), both (each number with its history under it) or line (the history with its label, no number). Which metrics are drawn is the per-metric switch above
dockChartMode.description[zh_CN]: 任务栏小程序怎么画各项读数：off 只显示数字，both 在数字下面加折线图，line 只画折线图（保留标签）。画哪几项由上面的显示项开关决定

refreshIntervalMs.name: Refresh interval
refreshIntervalMs.description: How often the readings are updated, in milliseconds
refreshIntervalMs.description[zh_CN]: 读数更新间隔，单位毫秒

fanScaleRpm.name: Fan gauge scale
fanScaleRpm.description: RPM the fan gauges treat as full speed, used when the chip does not report a ceiling
fanScaleRpm.description[zh_CN]: 风扇转速条的满量程，芯片未提供最高转速时使用

processCount.name: Processes listed
processCount.description: How many processes the panel lists
processCount.description[zh_CN]: 面板里列出的进程条数

processSort.name: Sort processes by
processSort.description: Whether the process list is ordered by cpu usage (cpu) or by memory (memory)
processSort.description[zh_CN]: 进程列表按 CPU 占用（cpu）还是按内存占用（memory）排序
